Fix on top of v0.6.0, same day.

- The curated skip list applies only to name tokens from build scripts
  (cmake/meson/make/autotools/configure). v0.6.0 could drop real
  packages whose names collide with build tooling — npm `bcrypt`,
  `threads`, `util`, pypi `numpy`, `mypy`. A resolved lockfile or
  build-output entry is a real installed package regardless of its
  name. Verified: the collector now yields the identical
  (name, version) set as the full jochwacht suite on a real project.
